text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Yup! Hair is styled nicely, and there aren't any wrinkles or creases on my collar and sleeves!
Now then, for breakfast—

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Oh my? Is the skin under my eyes a bit dry?
It was perfectly fine last night, though...

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
I took supplements to make up for what my meals lacked,
so I should have enough vitamins and minerals...
Did I slack off on UV protection?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: I'll apply a generous amount of moisturizing lotion and see how it goes...
